qualifications.requirement: Initial state is admitted. The literal absorption gate must hold at every pre-stop state, either via the sufficient uniform parameter gate or an explicit gate-exit stop. Entrance information alone does not propagate the gate.
Use pre-stop rates, include the actual crossing jump, and keep positive terminal E; padding or the stated integer E lower bound provides positivity.
Expectation statements use a fixed initial state, or are conditional on the entrance sigma-field; random D must otherwise be averaged. Occupation hitting is stopped continuously with no overshoot.
Uniform O(T^-2) needs uniformly bounded coefficients and positive lower bounds on c,e0; the tradeoff also needs theta,sigma bounded away from zero. Fixed-p constants need not be uniform in p.

For Qbar=2D, a T^3 exponent requires D of order T^3, as explicitly stated. High-e entrances may have D of order T. A deterministic ceiling must be used consistently in Qbar, variance, and lower martingale margin.
Finite m requires sigma=2km/(m+1)-3>0, not merely k>3/2; retain 2/N. The moderate-density conclusion additionally needs L/B<=1/10, B>=100 and E>=100, plus all remaining chosen domain stops.
